scope: Targeted primary-literature review, independent numerical reference and three full-column diagnostic controls. No empirical lunar validation or usable revised flake-size/optical forecast.
head: c4469bd6a12d56299c828ead08fe01280b8539bc

pytest.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest atmosphere/tests/test_snow*.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

layer_check.method: shared.check_layers Python/JS import and lane functions applied to git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard sources

kernel_diagnostic.verification_note: Initial raw Python comparison differed only because source_ids tuples serialize as JSON lists; normalized comparison passes.

deferred_reason: All three initial controls fail the finite size-domain check. No full-column convergence claim; wider forecast/refinement matrix deferred at this failure.

literature.substantive_reading: Geometry and strength notes and ledgers read for applicability and evidence scope; independent source-note review; final repair report read in full after inserting results.

independent_review.solver_reaction_conservation: Irregular grids spanning twenty mass decades; relative mass residual at most 1.65e-16, number stoichiometry residual at most 2.22e-16. Reported by geometry-review agent.
independent_review.report_and_tests: Reviewed independently; strengthened exported mass-budget/domain gate check and qualified shared-pivot/CDF wording.

limitations: Raw maximum step-CDF differences can include whole-bin jumps from roundoff-separated shared pivots (up to 1.11e-14 relative). This metric is excluded from interpretation.
Fixed-pivot and upwind mass/height transport introduce resolution error; two mass grids do not establish convergence or uniquely isolate diffusion.
Numerical-domain exits are explicitly excluded from snowfall; their large mass fractions invalidate use of the surviving size/optical outputs as lunar forecasts.
Geometry evolution, interception efficiency, whole-aggregate failure and finite humidity trajectories remain proposed physical extensions.
not_performed: The six listed additional full-column controls
Physical closure changes or an empirical mechanical calibration
New snowstorm rendering or reissue of original optical products
